grammar_title: 定语从句综合复习(限制/非限制 · 关系代词 who/which/that/whose · 关系副词 when/where/why 与介词+which)
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修第四册 Unit 4 Using language: Review attributive clauses。句子地道、围绕创业/玫瑰/经济主题,答案唯一(干扰项为错误关系词)。

points.overview: 先行词指人用 who(主)/whom(宾);指物用 which;所有格用 whose;先行词被 all/everything/the only/序数词修饰或为不定代词时只能用 that。

points.point: 关系副词 when/where/why 与介词+which
points.overview: 从句只缺状语时:时间用 when(=on/in which)、地点用 where(=in/at which)、原因用 why(=for which);介词后只能用 which,不用 where/when/that。

points.point: 非限制性定语从句(逗号 + which/who/whose · 整句指代 · of which/whom · as)
points.overview: 逗号后非限制性从句指人用 who/whom、指物用 which、所有格用 whose,绝不用 that;which 可指代前面整句话;"of which/whom"表部分;"As is known"为固定 as 从句。

questions.stem: The entrepreneur ____ started the rose farm is now famous all over Asia.
questions.explanation: 先行词 entrepreneur 指人、从句缺主语 → 用指人的关系代词 who。

questions.stem: The investors ____ we met in the studio liked her business plan.
questions.explanation: 先行词 investors 指人、在从句中作 met 的宾语、且要排除 who/that → 用 whom。

questions.stem: A bonus is money ____ rewards workers for their hard effort.
questions.explanation: 先行词 money 指物、从句缺主语、不与 who 同现 → 用指物的 which。

questions.stem: The company ____ products sell well across Asia is hiring more staff.
questions.explanation: 先行词 company、从句缺 products 前的所有格(公司的产品)→ 用 whose。

questions.stem: The customers ____ bought her roses last spring came back again.
questions.explanation: 先行词 customers 指人、从句缺主语 → 用 who。

questions.stem: This is the manager ____ trained all the new workers at the farm.
questions.explanation: 先行词 manager 指人、从句缺主语 → 用 who。

questions.stem: The flowers ____ the workers pick before sunrise are very fresh.
questions.explanation: 先行词 flowers 指物、从句缺 pick 的宾语 → 用 which。

questions.stem: The worker ____ idea saved the company money got a reward.
questions.explanation: 先行词 worker、从句缺 idea 前的所有格(工人的主意)→ 用 whose。

questions.stem: The plan ____ she presented on television finally won support.
questions.explanation: 先行词 plan 指物、从句缺 presented 的宾语 → 用 which。

questions.stem: There is the consultant ____ gave the young owner useful advice.
questions.explanation: 先行词 consultant 指人、从句缺主语 → 用 who。

questions.stem: The farmers ____ she hired last year all work very hard.
questions.explanation: 先行词 farmers 指人、在从句中作 hired 的宾语、排除 who/that → 用 whom。

questions.stem: The product ____ won the prize is completely organic.
questions.explanation: 先行词 product 指物、从句缺主语、不与 who 同现 → 用 which。

questions.stem: The girl ____ parents grow roses decided to study business.
questions.explanation: 先行词 girl、从句缺 parents 前的所有格(女孩的父母)→ 用 whose。

questions.stem: Everything ____ he said about the profit later proved true.
questions.explanation: 先行词为不定代词 everything,定语从句只能用 that,不用 which。

questions.stem: It was the only shop ____ stayed open after midnight.
questions.explanation: 先行词被 the only 修饰时,定语从句只能用 that。

questions.stem: The first customer ____ arrived in the morning got a free rose.
questions.explanation: 先行词被序数词 the first 修饰时,用 that 引导定语从句。

questions.stem: All ____ glitters is not gold, as the old saying goes.
questions.explanation: 先行词为不定代词 all,定语从句用 that,不用 which。

questions.stem: The brand ____ name is well known now sells abroad.
questions.explanation: 先行词 brand、从句缺 name 前的所有格(品牌的名字)→ 用 whose。

questions.stem: The team ____ he leads meets in the field every morning.
questions.explanation: 先行词 team 指物(机构)、从句缺 leads 的宾语 → 用 which。

questions.stem: The investor ____ we trusted most offered the largest sum.
questions.explanation: 先行词 investor 指人、作 trusted 的宾语、排除 who/that → 用 whom。

questions.stem: This is the valley ____ roses grow wild all year round.
questions.explanation: 先行词 valley 表地点、从句不缺主宾(只缺地点状语)→ 用关系副词 where(= in which)。

questions.stem: I will never forget the day ____ I started my own business.
questions.explanation: 先行词 day 表时间、从句只缺时间状语 → 用关系副词 when(= on which)。

questions.stem: That is the reason ____ she decided to return to her home town.
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason 表原因、从句缺原因状语 → 用关系副词 why(= for which)。

questions.stem: The town ____ she grew up has become famous for its roses.
questions.explanation: 先行词 town 表地点、从句只缺地点状语 → 用 where。

questions.stem: 2017 was the year ____ her small company was set up.
questions.explanation: 先行词 year 表时间、从句只缺时间状语 → 用 when。

questions.stem: Tell me the reason ____ the roses must be picked before sunrise.
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason、从句缺原因状语 → 用 why。

questions.stem: This is the little shop ____ we buy fresh flowers every week.
questions.explanation: 先行词 shop 表地点、从句只缺地点状语 → 用 where。

questions.stem: There was a moment ____ everyone in the village doubted her.
questions.explanation: 先行词 moment 表时间、从句只缺时间状语 → 用 when。

questions.stem: The greenhouse in ____ the roses grow stays warm in winter.
questions.explanation: 介词 in 后只能用 which,不能用 where/that;in which = where。

questions.stem: The early morning on ____ we pick the flowers is always busy.
questions.explanation: 介词 on 后只能用 which,不能用 when/that;on which = when。

questions.stem: This is the office ____ she makes all the big decisions.
questions.explanation: 先行词 office 表地点、从句只缺地点状语 → 用 where。

questions.stem: Do you remember the date ____ the big order was signed?
questions.explanation: 先行词 date 表时间、从句只缺时间状语 → 用 when。

questions.stem: The market ____ she sells her roses opens early at dawn.
questions.explanation: 先行词 market 表地点、从句只缺地点状语 → 用 where。

questions.stem: The day on ____ the TV show aired changed her whole life.
questions.explanation: 介词 on 后只能用 which;on which = when。

questions.stem: He carefully explained the reason ____ the profits had fallen.
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason、从句缺原因状语 → 用 why。

questions.stem: The village ____ she was born now grows roses for export.
questions.explanation: 先行词 village 表地点、从句只缺地点状语 → 用 where。

questions.stem: The week ____ the first orders arrived was extremely busy.
questions.explanation: 先行词 week 表时间、从句只缺时间状语 → 用 when。

questions.stem: There are times ____ running your own business feels very hard.
questions.explanation: 先行词 times 表时间、从句只缺时间状语 → 用 when。

questions.stem: The house in ____ she now lives is close to the rose fields.
questions.explanation: 介词 in 后只能用 which;in which = where。

questions.stem: This is the city ____ many young start-ups first begin.
questions.explanation: 先行词 city 表地点、从句只缺地点状语 → 用 where。

questions.stem: Zhang Yue, ____ grew up among roses, started her own farm.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句指人作主语,只能用 who;非限制性中不用 that。

questions.stem: She decided to grow roses, ____ surprised many of her friends.
questions.explanation: 关系词指代前面整句话、引导非限制性从句作主语 → 用 which。

questions.stem: My boss, ____ I respect very much, gave me a generous bonus.
questions.explanation: 非限制性从句中指人作宾语 → 用 whom;非限制性不用 that。

questions.stem: The roses, ____ smell is wonderful, sell out almost every day.
questions.explanation: 非限制性从句缺 smell 前的所有格(玫瑰的香味)→ 用 whose。

questions.stem: Mr Li, ____ company makes cosmetics, bought her whole crop.
questions.explanation: 非限制性从句缺 company 前的所有格(李先生的公司)→ 用 whose。

questions.stem: The deal suddenly failed, ____ disappointed the whole team.
questions.explanation: 关系词指代前面整句话、引导非限制性从句作主语 → 用 which。

questions.stem: She hired ten workers, all of ____ came from the same village.
questions.explanation: "all of + 关系代词"指人 → 用 whom(all of whom)。

questions.stem: He gave several reasons, none of ____ really convinced us.
questions.explanation: "none of + 关系代词"指物(reasons)→ 用 which(none of which)。

questions.stem: The factory has fifty machines, most of ____ are brand new.
questions.explanation: "most of + 关系代词"指物(machines)→ 用 which(most of which)。

questions.stem: Her parents, ____ still grow roses, are very proud of her.
questions.explanation: 非限制性从句指人作主语 → 用 who。

questions.stem: He invested all his savings, ____ was a very brave choice.
questions.explanation: 关系词指代前面整句话、引导非限制性从句作主语 → 用 which。

questions.stem: The manager, ____ we all trust completely, made the final call.
questions.explanation: 非限制性从句指人作宾语 → 用 whom。

questions.stem: Our products, ____ quality is high, are now sold overseas.
questions.explanation: 非限制性从句缺 quality 前的所有格(产品的质量)→ 用 whose。

questions.stem: ____ is well known, running a small business is never easy.
questions.explanation: "As is well known"为固定的 as 引导的非限制性从句,放句首,which 不能放句首。

questions.stem: She works extremely hard, ____ we all greatly admire.
questions.explanation: 关系词指代前面整件事、引导非限制性从句作 admire 的宾语 → 用 which。

questions.stem: Tom, ____ father runs a bank, knows a lot about money.
questions.explanation: 非限制性从句缺 father 前的所有格(汤姆的父亲)→ 用 whose。

questions.stem: The shop sells roses, ____ are all grown on a local farm.
questions.explanation: 非限制性从句指物(roses)作主语 → 用 which;非限制性不用 that。

questions.stem: There were many guests, some of ____ were rich investors.
questions.explanation: "some of + 关系代词"指人(guests)→ 用 whom(some of whom)。

questions.stem: The new plan worked very well, ____ pleased everyone at work.
questions.explanation: 关系词指代前面整句话、引导非限制性从句作主语 → 用 which。

questions.stem: Mary, ____ I met at the flower fair, runs a small shop.
questions.explanation: 非限制性从句指人作 met 的宾语 → 用 whom。
